name: VictoriaMetrics
description: Fast, resource-efficient time series database for long-term metrics, compatible with Prometheus and Grafana.

configFields.label: Password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Every request except /health needs the username admin and this password.

connection.title: Connect to VictoriaMetrics
connection.description: Use it as a Prometheus data source in Grafana, or as a remote_write target for Prometheus, with basic auth (username admin and the password below).

outputs.label: VictoriaMetrics
outputs.help: The built-in vmui query page is at /vmui.

firstLogin.note: Metrics are kept for one year in the victoriametrics_data volume. Send Prometheus data to /api/v1/write.

features.title: Long-term metrics
features.description: Store a year of metrics with high compression.

features.title: Prometheus compatible
features.description: Accepts remote_write and answers PromQL queries.

features.title: Protected by default
features.description: Basic auth with a generated password.
